correctness.rationale: D_{N,n}=Y_{N,n}-E[Y_{N,n}|F_{N,n-K_N}] is F_{N,n}-measurable and conditioned mean zero at lag K_N. For each residue r mod K_N, the terms D_{N,r+jK_N} are martingale differences along the subsequence filtration. Conditional Jensen gives uniform ||D||_p<=2M^(1/p), martingale p inequalities give O(m_r^(1/p)) for 1<p<=2 and O(m_r^(1/2)) for p>=2; Minkowski across K_N classes yields (K_N/N)^min(1-1/p,1/2). Clipping UI Y at B, applying bounded-variable result then taking N->infinity followed by B->infinity yields L1 convergence. For N=mK_N, shared independent block values X_j yield T_N=m^-1 sum X_j: sparse ±m^(1/p) with probability 1/m attain p<2 rate, Rademachers p>=2 rate, ±m sparse spikes contradict convergence with only first-moment bounds. Each construction can be checked analytically; no computation is invoked as an infinite proof.
